tactical.label: Tactical
tactical.description: Wide quiescence, low pruning, high initiative. Tests whether trade aversion is search-driven.

positional.label: Positional
positional.description: Structure-weighted, queen-shy. Reference point for the trade experiments.

liquidator.label: Liquidator
liquidator.description: Control: initiative off, king safety high. Should reproduce the original trade-everything behaviour.

greedy.label: Greedy
greedy.description: Material-only ablation. Isolates how much of move choice the positional terms actually own.
